title: Lakshya Sen clinches Kumamoto Masters Japan title, second consecutive BWF crown
indian_angle: Indian shuttler Lakshya Sen made history by becoming the first Indian to win the Kumamoto Masters Japan, securing his second BWF Tour title in a row.
summary: Lakshya Sen defeated Japan’s Koki Watanabe 13-21, 21-18, 21-14 to claim the Kumamoto Masters Japan Open, marking his second consecutive BWF Tour title after winning the HYLO Open.

title: Lakshya Sen makes history, first Indian to reach Japan Masters final
indian_angle: Indian shuttler Lakshya Sen became the first Indian to ever reach the final of the Japan Masters since its inception in 2023, a significant achievement for Indian badminton.
summary: Lakshya Sen secured his spot in the Japan Masters final, becoming the first Indian to achieve this feat, building on his recent HYLO Open victory.
